name: Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products
benefit: - Grant Assistance: A grant of 50% of the project cost up to a maximum of ₹2,00,00,000/- for cold storage facilities up to 5,000 metric tons capacity.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
